title: Social Monitor: Romania ranks last in EU for artificial intelligence use
summary: Romania ranks last in the European Union for the use of artificial intelligence by both individuals and companies, according to an analysis by the Social Monitor (Monitorul Social), a project of Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Romania. The report linked the low adoption rate to a wider deficit in basic digital skills. Only 17.8% of Romanians aged 16 to 74 used generative AI tools in 2025, compared with an EU average of 32.7%. Denmark led the bloc with a rate of 48.4%, according to Eurostat data cited in the report. The difference was greater in the workplace.
